integrated_closure_law: Except for quarantined pre-promotion trials, no component or phase is complete until its promoted form is reachable through the supported persistent Miter runtime and is exercised through the end-to-end assistant path.
constitutive_closure_law: The first always-on slice may be bounded in external reach, deployment scale and initially earned effect capabilities, but it must be complete in constitutive organization and open to general unfamiliar conversation, undertakings, endogenous participation, consequence and continuity. No supported path may interpret contact, form an undertaking, select a response or prepare an effect outside the Part-14 constitutive kernel.
